name: Lag reduction experiment v1 - sprite Y coordinate write 12 to 9 cycles
status: CPU-cycle equivalent patch; NOT benchmarked in gameplay; NOT guaranteed 60fps

patches.note: Old STA abs,X / DEC abs,X (12 cycles) -> SEC / SBC #1 / STA abs,X (9 cycles). The stored byte remains (A-1) modulo 256. Carry/status used afterward is restored by PLP at $C120. Saves 3 cycles per sprite tile, not 3 cycles per entire actor update.
